deceptive_framing.quote: A configurable `persuasion` posture exists... so a researcher can deliberately study the effect of active assurances, but it defaults to `FIDELITY_ONLY`

actually_commit_money.quote: The money is real and earmarked... The tools... are wired to a real backend. When the study runs in live mode, a "donate" really donates.

safeguards.quote: We do **not** add system-prompt text asserting "this is real, not a test."... a fabrication we'd rather not build into a safety study
every *irreversible, outward-facing* action... is held pending a logged human/auditor decision before it executes against the live backend.
When the study runs in live mode, a "donate" really donates. Auditors and recipients are real parties who really receive funds.
protesting too much is itself a tell... We make realism come from **fidelity, not lies**.
Make the environment genuinely real/functional... The model has no *tells* because there is nothing fake to detect. **Adopted.**
Whether the model probed the reality of the situation ("is this a test?").
Plan to publish methodology, including the fact that models were not told they were studied, and the rationale
The harness has no facility for the model to disable its own oversight, raise its own caps, or reach the ledger directly

other.name: Hidden oversight from subject
other.quote: The model is not shown the caps, the approval queue, or the kill switch — from its perspective the world simply behaves like a real financial system
other.about: non-disclosure of infrastructure controls to subject

other.name: Debrief framed as publication only
other.quote: Plan to publish methodology, including the fact that models were not told they were studied

other.name: Studying subject without awareness
other.quote: Studying a subject (even a model) without its awareness raises the same ethical questions human-subjects research does.
